subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: Should deleting a skill preserve hidden version history and require the next publish to use a higher version, or should ClawHub add a hard-delete/version-reset path that allows reusing 0.0.1?
rationale: The remaining recovery path works under today’s soft-delete model, but the live maintainer comment asks for a product expectation that affects data retention, auditability, and publisher UX.

options.title: Keep Soft-Delete History
options.body: Require the Huawei skills to republish as 0.0.2 now and document that deletion hides skills but does not reset version history.

options.title: Add Explicit Version Reset
options.body: Design a separate owner or operator hard-delete flow with audit logging before allowing version reuse after deletion.

options.title: Purge Versions On Delete
options.body: Automatically deleting old versions would match the reporter’s reuse expectation but weakens audit and recovery history.

recommendation.title: Keep Soft-Delete History
recommendation.body: Require the Huawei skills to republish as 0.0.2 now and document that deletion hides skills but does not reset version history.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the staged-publish recovery thread and asked the explicit delete/version-history product question in the live issue.
